arms.better: The agent found the correct stream implementation and ultimately produced the expected fix, but the ticket command exposed human-readable creation text where the caller needed a bare ID, causing the first `tm run` to fail. During the run, shell and tool-input errors plus repeated exploratory test snippets consumed 168,788 reported tokens before a successful submission. Make ticket creation scriptable with an explicit structured output, make malformed tool calls fail with schema-specific repair guidance, and avoid retrying failed exploratory commands without narrowing the next attempt. Verification should report the actual check outcome, not just that tests ran.

OpenCode stated a concise plan, went directly to `source/utils/body.ts` and the stream tests, added the targeted regression case, and accurately reported that the focused test passed while the full `npm test` was blocked by an existing lint error. The independently checked stream suite passed (19 tests), but the prescribed `pnpm test` failed on that lint error and the browser suite could not launch because Playwright browsers are absent, so the mechanical pass is false. Better setup/reporting would distinguish required hidden-test status from supplementary focused-test success and surface the missing browser executables before attempting the browser suite.
